clock_quality.rule: TE rows (adapter te:*, status live): ts = datetime.now(UTC) when the shared TE cache was read (<= 10 s after the fetch), so exact and conservative. yfinance fallback rows: ts is the 1m bar time: published, available_utc = bar time.

columns.meaning: feed observation clock for the row (raw ts unless a capture clock exists in the payload; see rule)
columns.name: fetched_utc

columns.meaning: availability lower bound: = fetched_utc for exact rows, source-stated instant for published rows, null for unvintaged
columns.name: available_utc

columns.meaning: exact | published | unvintaged (see README.md, Clock quality)
columns.name: clock_quality

columns.meaning: feed source tag (te:BRN, te:CO1:COM, yf-1m:BZ=F, yahoo:BZ=F)
columns.name: source_tag

columns.meaning: UTC day the feed appended the row (raw file name); availability is never later than the end of this day
columns.name: raw_file_date

columns.meaning: residual raw keys with no typed column (JSON object) or null
columns.name: extra_json

dedup_rule: exact duplicates share (ts, sha256 of scrubbed raw + asset/venue/price/currency/status/source); the first occurrence is kept
name: brent_quotes
